readback.NSIS: List the exact staged EXE members and scan the installed tree. Runtime update installs the signed staged EXE and scans after hiding legacy bundled models.
readback.DEB and AppImage: Scan each exact staged artifact after extraction. The AppImage serves as the full Linux updater, and the signed runtime AppImage is also extracted independently.
readback.DMG: Scan the read-only mounted volume before copying its app for native inference validation.
readback.full Mac updater: Verify the signature and stream the actual signed tar. Check regular anchors, format 2 stamp and macOS path aliases without extracting a second copy of the models.
readback.runtime Mac updater: Scan and safely unpack the signed tar, codesign-verify and scan the extracted app. Use that same app for migrated-model checks.

publication_gate.notes: Only exact same-run producer files, matching receipts and checksums may create both updater manifests. Receipt binds commit, target, filename, byte length and SHA-256, plus SHA-256 of adjacent signature where applicable.
